services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Looking for standard group admission without a dedicated docent? Simply book tickets online for the number in your party. Complimentary docent-led tours are offered at 1 pm on weekdays and at 11:30 am and 1 pm on weekends, and can accommodate groups of up to 15 guests. If your group is larger, or you'd like a docent-led tour at a different time or focused on a specific exhibition or gallery, please book a Private Group Tour instead. Experience the Santa Barbara Museum of Art through an engaging private led tour featuring highlights from SBMA's permanent collection and current exhibitions.
